notes: Local tests are same-Mac encoder/decoder and fixed UDP loopback; not physical display or WAN latency.
Noise run used the submittedFrames instrumentation before the desktop source was added; the noise generator and native encoder were not modified.
Desktop is an explicitly labeled synthetic document/code scrolling workload, not actual window capture.
Actual video bitrate below the ceiling is expected for compressible content; no padding is used to reach 20 Mbps.
No H.264 rate-control or frame-dropper fix is claimed for raw noise. Existing codec/pacing/wire behavior remains in use.

nativeDirect.scope: single Mac native encoder only; no network, transport or decoder qualification

remoteDesktop.clientFeedback: User reports 60 fps and smooth scrolling
remoteDesktop.scope: Mac to remote iPhone via Surge Ponte, host telemetry and user feedback; receiver JSON and outer topology not observed
remoteDesktop.sampling: Live last-five snapshots polled once a second and deduplicated by session seconds; initial snapshot predates collector. No reconnect/counter reset observed. Frame rates derived from cumulative deltas; other summaries use sampled interval metrics.
